What's up everyone!

Someone dropped an anon recommendation, and I just couldn't resist picking this up. I'm taking over this project to give it the love it deserves!

Expect fully uncensored chapters and brand new translations for the missing updates. For the chapters already out there, I'll be using existing scripts and dropping major credits to the original teams at the end of each chapter.

This is a weekly ongoing project, but expect rapid-fire releases while I catch up on the older translated chapters. But if some chapters demand a lot of decensoring I will take my time doing a good job instead of rushing it.

It also features a wide variety of themes, from innocent low-statured lolis to ghost stories. Packed with plenty of tanned lolis to satisfy you!!
